sentences.en: Run squirrelrdf.Query with dw.ttl (the name of the mapping file) and test.rq (the name of the query file) as arguments.

sentences.en: Note that each object reference, obj, rq, and wr, are all strong references.

sentences.en: RQ means your reservation is only requested but not confirmed.

sentences.en: Conclusions Detection of target gene expression in paraffin - embedded tissues is feasible by RT - PCR or RQ - PCR .

sentences.en: Her six-question self-assessment test is a good starting place to measure your own RQ, or romantic quotient.
